== Ingredients ==
* 125 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] (½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]]) plain [[Cookbook:Yogurt|yoghurt]]
* 125 g (½ cup) water
* 2 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Honey|honey]]
* 250 g (1 cup) [[Cookbook:All-purpose flour|all-purpose flour]]

== Preparation ==
#Wash a glass jar with water and leave it wet. Sterilize by microwaving it for 4 minutes.
#Mix the water, yoghurt, and honey in the jar. Screw on the cap loosely, and let stand for 3–4 days until bubbly.
#Add the flour and mix well. Let rest until doubled in volume.
#Proceed to the final assembly stage in [[Cookbook:Pain au levain naturel|pain au levain naturel]].
